FUSEKIT FIX BUILT AND GREEN (branch fix/holder-drop-limit-load-session-type in /tmp/repin-wave/fusekit, uncommitted): holder/plan.go:411 assignment dropped; plan_test.go:712 asserts field zero AND the rendered plist contains no key (uniform with captain-hook's guard). Repo-wide sweep: those were the only sites — fusekit emits exactly one LaunchAgent. Verified via scripts/test.sh (full holder package green, 350s) plus vet/pure-build/cross-compile — every CI gate.

MECHANISM CORRECTION for this record: the installed-bad-plist replacement on live machines does NOT come from fusekit's plan digest/sameAgent (both self-referential; construction and verification move together, so no fusekit test breaks) — it comes from daemonkit's stored-agent exact field-set comparison (controller_state.go:907 carries LimitLoadToSessionType in the stored shape), which makes the recorded installed agent compare unequal to the new desired agent and triggers bootout-and-replace on converge. Same effect as predicted, machinery one repo down.

All four wave diffs now built: synckit (both halves + seam), captain-hook, fusekit, cc-notes (staged half). Remaining before ship: daemonkit StableProgramFrom lane + four sol reviews + synthesis. Also filed in fusekit backlog: a proven pre-existing load-sensitive readiness flake in holder tests (fails on unmodified main under -count=5 at ~950 uid procs) — expect it in wave CI runs on loaded machines.
